name: depot-cache-disk-probe
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: 'false'
  PROBE_COHORT: monochromatic-disk-20261018T0503-trusted-v1
jobs:
  seed:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    env:
      PROBE_ROLE: seed
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@c2a87611a18de5b3828c5652fe268e992400cb5c
        with:
          # Freeze the task bootstrap for this experiment and avoid release-discovery API calls.
          version: 2026.10.9
          install: false
          cache: false
      - run: mise install node
      - name: Verify fresh sandbox and inspect preinstalled Archil
        id: preflight
        working-directory: .depot/probe/cache-disk
        run: mise run //.depot/probe/cache-disk:preflight
      - uses: depot/cache-mount@38d61fd25163e9ef3a3eff8a61676994d306e549
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.preflight.outputs.mount-path }}
          name: ${{ env.PROBE_COHORT }}
          debug: 'true'
      - name: Publish bounded persistent fixture
        working-directory: .depot/probe/cache-disk
        run: mise run //.depot/probe/cache-disk:exercise
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: depot-cache-disk-seed
          path: ${{ steps.preflight.outputs.evidence-path }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
  readers:
    needs: seed
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 2
      matrix:
        role: [reader-a, reader-b]
    env:
      PROBE_ROLE: ${{ matrix.role }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@c2a87611a18de5b3828c5652fe268e992400cb5c
        with:
          # Freeze the task bootstrap for this experiment and avoid release-discovery API calls.
          version: 2026.10.9
          install: false
          cache: false
      - run: mise install node
      - name: Verify fresh sandbox and inspect preinstalled Archil
        id: preflight
        working-directory: .depot/probe/cache-disk
        run: mise run //.depot/probe/cache-disk:preflight
      - uses: depot/cache-mount@38d61fd25163e9ef3a3eff8a61676994d306e549
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.preflight.outputs.mount-path }}
          name: ${{ env.PROBE_COHORT }}
          debug: 'true'
      - name: Read seed and verify disjoint concurrent writers
        working-directory: .depot/probe/cache-disk
        run: mise run //.depot/probe/cache-disk:exercise
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: depot-cache-disk-${{ matrix.role }}
          path: ${{ steps.preflight.outputs.evidence-path }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

run = '''
const {readFileSync,writeFileSync,mkdirSync,chmodSync,existsSync,appendFileSync}=await import('node:fs');const {homedir,hostname,totalmem,availableParallelism}=await import('node:os');const {join}=await import('node:path');const {execFileSync,spawnSync}=await import('node:child_process');const {createHash}=await import('node:crypto');const {strict:assert}=await import('node:assert');const sha=b=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');const root=process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE;assert(root);const scratch=join(homedir(),'temp/agent');mkdirSync(scratch,{recursive:true,mode:0o700});chmodSync(scratch,0o700);const evidence=join(scratch,'depot-cache-disk-evidence');mkdirSync(evidence,{recursive:true,mode:0o700});const mount=join(scratch,'depot-cache-disk-mount');mkdirSync(mount,{recursive:true,mode:0o700});const isolation=join(scratch,'depot-cache-disk-private-job-marker.json');const absent=!existsSync(isolation);const head=execFileSync('git',['rev-parse','HEAD'],{cwd:root,encoding:'utf8'}).trim();const archil='/usr/bin/archil';const preinstalled=existsSync(archil);const version=preinstalled?spawnSync(archil,['--version'],{encoding:'utf8',timeout:10000}):null;const proof={schemaVersion:1,phase:'preflight',createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),cohort:process.env.PROBE_COHORT,role:process.env.PROBE_ROLE,sourceHead:head,inputs:{workflow:sha(readFileSync(join(root,'.depot/workflows/depot-cache-disk-probe.yml'))),tasks:sha(readFileSync('mise.toml'))},runner:{hostname:hostname(),bootId:readFileSync('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','utf8').trim(),cpus:availableParallelism(),memoryBytes:totalmem(),node:process.version,job:process.env.GITHUB_JOB??null},privateMarkerAbsent:absent,mountWasAbsentFromMountinfo:!readFileSync('/proc/self/mountinfo','utf8').split('\n').some(line=>line.split(' ')[4]===mount),archil:{preinstalled,sha256:preinstalled?sha(readFileSync(archil)):null,versionStatus:version?.status??null,versionStdout:version?.stdout??null,versionStderr:version?.stderr??null}};writeFileSync(join(evidence,'preflight.json'),JSON.stringify(proof,null,2)+'\n');appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT,'mount-path='+mount+'\nevidence-path='+evidence+'\narchil-preinstalled='+preinstalled+'\n');console.log('DISK_PROOF '+JSON.stringify(proof));assert(absent,'Private prior-job marker was present');assert(proof.mountWasAbsentFromMountinfo,'Mount existed before the action');writeFileSync(isolation,JSON.stringify({cohort:proof.cohort,role:proof.role,hostname:proof.runner.hostname}));assert(preinstalled,'Archil is not preinstalled; refusing the action floating quiet = true
shell = "node --input-type=module-typescript -e"
run = '''
const {readFileSync,writeFileSync,openSync,fsyncSync,closeSync,renameSync,existsSync,mkdirSync}=await import('node:fs');const {homedir,hostname}=await import('node:os');const {join}=await import('node:path');const {createHash}=await import('node:crypto');const {setTimeout:wait}=await import('node:timers/promises');const {strict:assert}=await import('node:assert');const sha=b=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');const scratch=join(homedir(),'temp/agent');const evidence=join(scratch,'depot-cache-disk-evidence');const mount=join(scratch,'depot-cache-disk-mount');const before=JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(evidence,'preflight.json'),'utf8'));const role=process.env.PROBE_ROLE;const cohort=process.env.PROBE_COHORT;const entries=readFileSync('/proc/self/mountinfo','utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(line=>{const parts=line.split(' ');const separator=parts.indexOf('-');return {mountId:parts[0],parentId:parts[1],device:parts[2],mountPoint:parts[4],options:parts[5],filesystemType:parts[separator+1]}}).filter(row=>row.mountPoint===mount);assert.equal(entries.length,1,'Expected exactly one real mount after the cache action');assert.equal(sha(readFileSync('/usr/bin/archil')),before.archil.sha256,'Archil changed after preflight');function atomic({path,value}){const temp=path+'.'+role+'.pending';const fd=openSync(temp,'wx',0o600);writeFileSync(fd,value);fsyncSync(fd);closeSync(fd);renameSync(temp,path)}const manifestPath=join(mount,'seed-manifest.json');const payloadPath=join(mount,'payload.bin');const start=new Date().toISOString();let seed;let writers=[];if(role==='seed'){assert(!existsSync(manifestPath),'Unique disk unexpectedly contains an existing manifest');assert(!existsSync(payloadPath),'Unique disk unexpectedly contains an existing payload');const payload=Buffer.alloc(1024*1024);const pattern=Buffer.from(cohort+'|'+before.sourceHead+'|cache persistence fixture\n');for(let offset=0;offset<payload.length;offset+=pattern.length)pattern.copy(payload,offset,0,Math.min(pattern.length,payload.length-offset));seed={schemaVersion:1,cohort,sourceHead:before.sourceHead,payloadBytes:payload.length,payloadSha256:sha(payload),producerHostname:hostname(),producerBootId:before.runner.bootId,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()};atomic({path:payloadPath,value:payload});atomic({path:manifestPath,value:JSON.stringify(seed)+'\n'});}else{assert(['reader-a','reader-b'].includes(role));seed=JSON.parse(readFileSync(manifestPath,'utf8'));assert.equal(seed.cohort,cohort);assert.equal(seed.sourceHead,before.sourceHead);const payload=readFileSync(payloadPath);assert.equal(payload.length,seed.payloadBytes);assert.equal(sha(payload),seed.payloadSha256);const own=join(mount,role);mkdirSync(own,{recursive:false,mode:0o700});const ownPayload=Buffer.from((cohort+'|'+role+'|').repeat(512));atomic({path:join(own,'payload.bin'),value:ownPayload});const record={cohort,role,sourceHead:before.sourceHead,hostname:hostname(),bootId:before.runner.bootId,bytes:ownPayload.length,sha256:sha(ownPayload),publishedAt:new Date().toISOString()};atomic({path:join(own,'manifest.json'),value:JSON.stringify(record)+'\n'});const peer=role==='reader-a'?'reader-b':'reader-a';const peerManifest=join(mount,peer,'manifest.json');const deadline=Date.now()+45000;while(!existsSync(peerManifest)&&Date.now()<deadline)await wait(250);assert(existsSync(peerManifest),'Concurrent peer manifest did not become visible within the bounded probe');for(const writer of ['reader-a','reader-b']){const item=JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(mount,writer,'manifest.json'),'utf8'));assert.equal(item.cohort,cohort);assert.equal(item.sourceHead,before.sourceHead);const bytes=readFileSync(join(mount,writer,'payload.bin'));assert.equal(bytes.length,item.bytes);assert.equal(sha(bytes),item.sha256);writers.push(item)}}const proof={schemaVersion:1,phase:'consumer',startedAt:start,finishedAt:new Date().toISOString(),cohort,role,sourceHead:before.sourceHead,runner:before.runner,privateMarkerAbsent:before.privateMarkerAbsent,mounts:entries,archil:before.archil,seed,writers,assertions:{realMount:true,sourceHeadMatched:true,payloadHashMatched:true,privateJobIsolationMarkerAbsent:true,disjointWritesAndPeerReads:role==='seed'?null:true},bounds:{payloadBytes:1024*1024,peerVisibilityWaitMilliseconds:45000,requestedCpus:2,requestedMemoryGb:8,jobTimeoutMinutes:5}};writeFileSync(join(evidence,'consumer.json'),JSON.stringify(proof,null,2)+'\n');console.log('DISK_PROOF '+JSON.stringify(proof));
'''
